name: sample-kit-guided
title: Sample AI kit: weekly status
description: A small starter AI kit that writes a weekly status summary from StatusLog work items. Copy it to start your own.

settings.label: Look-back days
settings.description: How many days of activity the summary covers.

settings.label: Include blocked work
settings.description: Add a short section for items that look stuck.

settings.label: Notes link
settings.description: Optional link to team notes or a handbook, mentioned at the end of the summary.

tools.name: status_report_outline
tools.description: Get the outline to follow when writing a weekly status summary.

tools.name: week_range
tools.description: Print the Monday to Sunday date range of the week containing a date (default: today).

date.description: A date as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.
